title: A bonus paid first
hook: Two stated cases: explore the difference between a path and its final cash balance.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the difference between a path and its final cash balance affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the difference between a path and its final cash balance in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
